mainEntity.name: Can AI build my sales funnel, emails, and landing pages, or do I still need a marketer?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can help draft a funnel, but it cannot guarantee conversions. Run My AI Biz describes connected materials such as an opt-in page, lead magnet, bridge page, thank-you page, sales page, and email follow-up, with review before publication. Context: A funnel works only when the offer, audience, promise, proof, message, page experience, and follow-up align. Generating more copy will not fix a weak offer or unclear customer problem. Key factors: - Match the lead magnet to the next offer. - Make each page answer the customer’s next reasonable question. - Track sign-ups, delivery, clicks, replies, sales, and drop-off points. Practical guidance: Build the smallest complete path first and test links, delivery, mobile display, unsubscribe handling, and message consistency. Improve one weak stage at a time rather than changing the whole funnel without evidence.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can draft funnel components, emails, and landing-page copy, but it cannot guarantee conversions or replace offer and audience judgment. Build a small complete path, test delivery and links, track each stage, and revise based on actual customer behavior.
